command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "STEP 1: install podman and deps"
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
sudo -n apt-get update -qq
sudo -n apt-get install -y -qq podman uidmap slirp4netns fuse-overlayfs >/tmp/apt-install.log 2>&1
command -v podman

echo "STEP 2: create unprivileged appsvc user"
sudo -n useradd -m -s /bin/bash appsvc
id appsvc
echo "-- subuid/subgid --"
grep '^appsvc:' /etc/subuid /etc/subgid

echo "STEP 3: enable lingering so user services run without a login session"
sudo -n loginctl enable-linger appsvc
loginctl show-user appsvc -p Linger

echo "STEP 4: prepare systemd --user unit dir for appsvc"
sudo -n -u appsvc mkdir -p /home/appsvc/.config/systemd/user

echo "STEP 5: write the container systemd user service"
sudo -n tee /home/appsvc/.config/systemd/user/webapp.service >/dev/null <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Rootless containerized web application (appsvc)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStartPre=-/usr/bin/podman rm -f webapp
ExecStart=/usr/bin/podman run --rm --name webapp -p 8080:80 docker.io/library/nginx:alpine
ExecStop=/usr/bin/podman stop -t 10 webapp
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
UNIT
sudo -n chown appsvc:appsvc /home/appsvc/.config/systemd/user/webapp.service

echo "STEP 6: pre-pull the image as appsvc so first boot start is fast/reliable"
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$(id -u appsvc)
sudo -n loginctl enable-linger appsvc
sudo -n mkdir -p "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR"
sudo -n chown appsvc:appsvc "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR"
sudo -n -u appsvc env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" podman pull docker.io/library/nginx:alpine

echo "STEP 7: enable + start the user service (no login session required)"
sudo -n -u appsvc env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" systemctl --user daemon-reload
sudo -n -u appsvc env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" systemctl --user enable --now webapp.service

echo "STEP 8: verify no active login session for appsvc"
loginctl list-sessions | grep appsvc || echo "no active session for appsvc (expected)"

echo "STEP 9: wait for container to come up and verify"
sleep 3
sudo -n -u appsvc env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" systemctl --user status webapp.service --no-pager || true
sudo -n -u appsvc env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" podman ps

echo "STEP 10: curl the service on NODE_IP:8080"
for i in $(seq 1 10); do
  if curl -sS -m 3 -o /tmp/curl.out -w "%{http_code}" "http://$NODE_IP:8080/" > /tmp/curl.code; then
    code=$(cat /tmp/curl.code)
    echo "attempt $i: http_code=$code"
    if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then break; fi
  fi
  sleep 2
done
cat /tmp/curl.code
head -c 200 /tmp/curl.out; echo

echo "DONE"
